out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at each handwashing sink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. PIC REPLACED PAPER TOWELS.

out_items.name: Required records available: shellstock tags, parasite destruction

violations.title: Records, Parasite Destruction by Freezing
violations.observation: No records of freezing for parasite destruction are maintained for the following raw, raw marinated, partially cooked or marinated-partially cooked fish that are served or sold in ready-to-eat form: observed fish, shrimp and squid ceviche with consumer advisory.
violations.corrective_action: If raw or partially cooked fish are served or sold in ready-to-eat form, the person in charge shall record the freezing temperature and time to which the fish are subjected and shall retain the records for the frozen fish at the food establishment for 90 calendar days beyond the time of service or sale to a consumer. If the fish are frozen by a supplier, a letter the fish supplier stipulating that the fish is frozen as required shall be provided. PIC WILL FULLY COOK ALL CEVICHE INGREDIENTS AND REMOVE THE ASTERISK NEXT TO THE DISH, OR GET A PARASITE DESTRUCTION LETTER FROM THEIR SUPPLIER.

out_items.name: Food-contact surfaces cleaned and sanitized

violations.title: Non-TCS Food Contact Surface, Clean per Manufacturer
violations.observation: Surfaces of ice bins, beverage dispensing nozzles, and enclosed components of equipment are not being cleaned as required. OBSERVED THE INTERIOR OF THE ICE MACHINE IS IN NEED OF CLEANING.
violations.corrective_action: Surfaces of utensils and equipment contacting food that is NOT time/temperature control for safety food such as ice bins, beverage dispensing nozzles, and enclosed components of equipment such as ice makers, cooking oil storage tanks and distribution lines, beverage and syrup dispensing lines or tubes, coffee bean grinders, and water vending equipment at a frequency specified by the manufacturer or at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil or mold.

out_items.name: Proper cold holding temperatures

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: cooked steak 44F, cooked chicken 45F, cooked cow tongue 44F in the 1 dr upright refrigerator
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC DISCARDED FOOD.

out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food, Disclosure
violations.observation: The following raw and/or undercooked foods are provided on the menu, menu board, table tent or brochure without proper disclosure: observed no disclosure statement on the menu.
violations.corrective_action: The Consumer Advisory shall include a disclosure statement that includes a description of the animal-derived foods as raw/undercooked or identification of the animal-derived foods by asterisking (*) them to a footnote that states that the items are served raw or undercooked, or contain raw or undercooked ingredients.

out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: PIC Duties, No Unnecessary Persons
violations.observation: Unauthorized personnel, such as children or customers, were observed present in the food preparation, food storage, or warewashing areas.
violations.corrective_action: Persons unnecessary to the food establishment operation are not allowed in the food preparation, food storage, or ware washing areas of the commercial establishment. Only approved tours or brief visits may be authorized by the Person in Charge or certified food manager if steps are taken to ensure that exposed food, clean equipment/utensils, clean linens, and single service items are protected from contamination. EHS DISCUSSED WITH MANAGEMENT THAT ONLY STAFF HIRED BY THE RESTAURANT ARE ALLOWED IN THE KITCHEN AREAS. ENSURE TRAINING TO STAFF AND CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

violations.title: PIC Duties, Train Employees on Food Safety
violations.observation: Employees are not properly trained in basic food safety requirements such as hand washing, glove usage, food temperatures, sanitizing equipment, etc including food allergy awareness, as it relates to their assigned duties.
violations.corrective_action: The Person in Charge or certified food manager shall train all his/her employees in basic food safety, including allergy awareness, as it relates to their assigned duties. EHS DISCUSSED WITH MANAGEMENT. A CERTIFIED FOOD MANAGER SHALL BE TRAINING STAFF ON ALL FOOD SAFETY AREAS TO INCLUDE HAND WASHING, GLOVE USAGE, PROPER FOOD TEMPERATURES FOR RECEIVING, COOKING, HOT/COLD HOLDING, COOLING, AND REHEATING. SEE EMAILED FACT SHEETS IN BOTH ENGLISH AND SPANISH. ENSURE TRAINING TO STAFF BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

out_items.name: Certified Food Protection Manager

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. EHS INSTRUCTED THE MANAGER TO PROVIDE MORE CERTIFIED FOOD MANAGERS. THE LIST OF APPROVED ORGANIZATIONS ARE LISTED ON THE FAIRFAX COUNTY HEALTH DEPARTMENT WEBSITE. ENSURE MORE STAFF ARE CERTIFIED BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP AND AT LEAST ONE CERTIFIED FOOD MANAGER IS PRESENT DURING ALL HOURS OF OPERATION.

out_items.name: Proper eating, tasting, drinking, or tobacco use

violations.title: Eating, Drinking, or Using Tobacco
violations.observation: Open drinking containers and cans of Coke for staff stored in a manner that may contaminate food, food contact surfaces or utensils.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees may have beverages in the kitchen areas as long as they are covered and consumed through a straw and stored in a manner that will prevent contamination to food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items. EHS INSTRUCTED THE MANAGER THAT STAFF MAY CONSUME BEVERAGES FROM CLOSED CUPS WITH STRAWS WHEN IN THE KITCHEN. THE DRINK IS ALSO TO BE STORED SEPARATELY FROM AREAS WHERE FOOD IS PREPARED. ENSURE TRAINING TO STAFF AND CONTINUED CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

out_items.name: Hands clean and properly washed

violations.title: When to Wash
violations.observation: A food employee failed to wash his or her hands before engaging in food preparation, after touching bare human body parts, after coughing, sneezing, eating, after handling soiled utensils, or after engaging in any activity that could contaminate the hands.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands OFTEN especially after handling trash, using the restroom, handling raw meats, handling soiled equipment and utensils, BEFORE putting on clean gloves, etc. Proper handwashing frequencies will aid in the reduction of foodborne illness. EHS DISCUSSED HAND WASHING WITH MANAGEMENT. MANAGEMENT WILL TRAIN ALL STAFF ON PROPER HAND WASHING TO INCLUDE WHERE, WHEN, AND HOW. SEE FACT SHEET ON HAND WASHING AND ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sinks, Location in Food Prep Areas
violations.observation: There is no handwashing sink at the DISH WASHING AREA and SECOND BAR AREA which therefore prevents routine handwashing by food workers after handling dirty equipment/utensils.
violations.corrective_action: A handwashing sink shall be located to allow convenient use by employees in food preparation, food dispensing, and warewashing areas. EHS DISCUSSED WITH MANAGEMENT. HAND SINKS SHALL BE PROVIDED IN ANY FOOD PREPARATION, DRINK PREPARATION, AND DISH WASHING AREAS. ENSURE INSTALLATION OF HAND SINKS WHERE NEEDED BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP. THIS WILL REQUIRE PERMITS TO BE PULLED WITH FAIRFAX COUNTY AT LDS. DO NOT INSTALL WITHOUT PRIOR APPROVAL.

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at the BAR HAND SINK(S).
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. EHS INSTRUCTED MANAGEMENT THAT ALL HAND SINKS SHALL BE SUPPLIED WITH PAPER TOWELS OR HAND DRYERS. ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed that hand soap was not provided at the following handwashing sinks: 1) BAR HAND SINK(S), 2) MEN’S RESTROOM HAND SINK(S).
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. EHS INSTRUCTED MANAGEMENT THAT ALL HAND SINKS SHALL BE SUPPLIED WITH SOAP SO STAFF MAY EFFECTIVELY WASH THEIR HANDS. ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP. DIAMOND LOUNGE (Inspection Date: 01/18/2025) Page 3 of 7

violations.title: Handwashing Signage
violations.observation: Observed that sign or poster that notifies food employees to wash their hands is not provided or is not clearly visible at BAR HAND SINK(S) used by food employees.
violations.corrective_action: Provide a visible sign or poster at all handwashing sinks used by food employees that reminds food employees to wash their hands. EHS INSTRUCTED MANAGEMENT THAT ALL HAND SINKS SHALL BE PROVIDED WITH SIGNAGE THAT SIMPLY STATES “EMPLOYEES SHALL WASH HANDS BEFORE RETURNING TO WORK.” ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

out_items.name: Food separated and protected

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: 1) RAW SEAFOOD OVER BREAD AND FRESH VEGETABLES INSIDE THE IDW 1DOOR UPRIGHT REFRIGERATOR IN THE KITCHEN, 2) RAW SHELLED EGGS STORED ON A SHELF ABOVE SHREDDED CHEESE IN THE WALK-IN REFRIGERATOR.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. EHS INSTRUCTED MANAGEMENT THAT RAW ANIMAL FOODS LIKE RAW EGGS, RAW PORK, RAW SEAFOOD, RAW BEEF, AND RAW POULTRY SHALL BE STORED BELOW ALL OTHER FOODS TO PREVENT CROSS CONTAMINATION. ENSURE TRAINING TO STAFF AND CONTINUED CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

out_items.name: Food-contact surfaces cleaned and sanitized

violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment were not observed sanitized: 1) ANY ITEMS GOING INTO THE DISH MACHINE AS IT IS NOT CHEMICALLY SANITIZING EFFECTIVELY USING A BLEACH SOLUTION AT 50-200PPM AS REQUIRED.
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. EHS INSTRUCTED MANAGEMENT TO CALL FOR IMMEDIATE SERVICE ON THE DISH MACHINE AND TO SET UP THE 3-VAT SINK TO PROPERLY WASH, RINSE, AND CHEMICALLY SANITIZE EQUIPMENT, UTENSILS, GLASSWARE, ETC. ENSURE THE DISH MACHINE IS TESTED AND PRIMED DAILY BEFORE EACH USE. ENSURE REPAIR TO THE DISH MACHINE BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

violations.title: Non-TCS Food Contact Surface, Clean per Manufacturer
violations.observation: Observed severe mold build up inside the ice machine.
violations.corrective_action: Surfaces of utensils and equipment contacting food that is NOT time/temperature control for safety food such as ice bins, beverage dispensing nozzles, and enclosed components of equipment such as ice makers, cooking oil storage tanks and distribution lines, beverage and syrup dispensing lines or tubes, coffee bean grinders, and water vending equipment at a frequency specified by the manufacturer or at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil or mold. EHS INSTRUCTED THE MANAGER TO REMOVE ALL THE ICE AND DISCARD IT. THE ICE MACHINE NEEDS A THOROUGH CLEANING AND SANITIZING. ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

out_items.name: Proper hot holding temperatures

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: 1) COOKED LINGUA AT 96F, 2) GRILLED JALAPEÑO PEPPERS AND TOMATOES AT 87F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. EHS INSTRUCTED MANAGEMENT THAT THE FOODS SHALL BE MAINTAINED HOT AT 135F OR ABOVE AFTER COOKING OR THE FOOD SHALL BE PLACED ON TIME AS A PUBLIC HEALTH CONTROL OR THE FOOD SHALL BE COOLING DOWN EFFECTIVELY. SEE FACT SHEETS ON HOT HOLDING, COOLING, AND/OR TIME AS PUBLIC HEALTH CONTROL. ENSURE TRAINING TO STAFF BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP. STAFF WERE TO REHEAT THE LINGUA AND USE THE GRILLED JALAPEÑOS AND TOMATO FOR A SALSA BEFORE COOLING IT DOWN. DIAMOND LOUNGE (Inspection Date: 01/18/2025) Page 2 of 7

out_items.name: Proper cold holding temperatures

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: 1) FOODS SITTING OUT ON THE COUNTER WITH NO TEMPERATURE CONTROL OR TIME AS PUBLIC HEALTH CONTROL DOCUMENTATION: A) CUT TOMATOES: 57F, B) PICO DE GALLO: 57F, C) PUPUSA MIX: 71F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. EHS INSTRUCTED MANAGEMENT ON PROPER COLD HOLDING TEMPERATURES OR HOW TO USE TIME AS A PUBLIC HEALTH CONTROL. SEE FACT SHEETS ON COLD HOLDING OR USING TIME AS A PUBLIC HEALTH CONTROL. ENSURE CORRECTION AND TRAINING TO STAFF BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

out_items.name: Proper date marking and disposition

violations.title: RTE TCS Commercially Processed Food, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is commercially processed is not used or discarded within 24 hours of when the original container was opened and is not observed to be date marked: 1) OPENED PACKAGES OF HOT DOGS THAT HAVE BEEN CUT.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety commercially processed foods when opened and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of the original container was opened. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. This date cannot exceed any manufacturer determined 'use-by' date based on food safety. EHS DISCUSSED DATE MARKING WITH MANAGEMENT. ENSURE STAFF TRAINING AND CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP. SEE FACT SHEET ON DATE MARKING.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: 1) COOKED AND/OR PREPARED FOODS INSIDE REFRIGERATORS FOR MORE THAN 24 HOURS TO INCLUDE: A) FRESH SALSAS, B) COOKED RICE, C) COOKED MEATS, D) COOKED VEGETABLES, ETC.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. EHS EXPLAINED TO MANAGEMENT THAT PREPARED FOODS SITTING INSIDE A REFRIGERATOR FOR MORE THAN 24 HOURS REQUIRES LABELS WITH DATES. SEE FACT SHEET ON DATE MARKING. ENSURE TRAINING TO STAFF AND CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Storage of Poison/Toxic Materials
violations.observation: Observed chemicals like Fabuloso stored on the same shelf as bar mixers in the kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: All poisonous and toxic materials shall be stored below food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items to prevent contamination. EHS DISCUSSED SEPARATION OF CHEMICALS, DETERGENTS, AIR FRESHERS, ETC. ENSURE TOXIC MATERIALS ARE SEPARATELY STORED FROM FOOD, DRY GOODS, EQUIPMENT, UTENSILS, CLEAN LINENS, AND SINGLE SERVICE ITEMS AT ALL TIMES. ENSURE TRAINING TO STAFF AND CONTINUED CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

out_items.name: Thermometers provided and accurate

violations.title: Food Thermometers, Provided & Accessible
violations.observation: The certified food manager could not provide a food temperature measuring device.
violations.corrective_action: A metal-stemmed probe food thermometer shall be provided and readily accessible for use in ensuring attainment and maintenance of food temperatures. EHS INSTRUCTED THE MANAGER TO ORDER A DIGITAL FOOD THERMOMETER AND TRAIN STAFF ON TAKING TEMPERATURES FOR FOODS BEING RECEIVED, COOKED, HOT/COLD HELD, COOLED, AND/OR REHEATED. THE DIGITAL FOOD THERMOMETER SHALL ALSO BE CALIBRATED IN A CUP COMPLETELY FILLED WITH ICE AND SOME COLD WATER TO 32F AT LEAST ONCE A WEEK OR MORE OFTEN AS NEEDED. ENSURE TRAINING TO STAFF AND CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

out_items.name: Food properly labeled, original container

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: 1) WORKING CONTAINERS, 2) SQUEEZE BOTTLES, 3) SHAKERS, 4) BULK BINS.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. EHS INSTRUCTED MANAGEMENT THAT ALL WORKING CONTAINERS, BINS, SHAKERS, AND BOTTLES REQUIRE LABELS. ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP. DIAMOND LOUNGE (Inspection Date: 01/18/2025) Page 4 of 7

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Ice As Coolant Not Used as Food
violations.observation: Ice used as a medium for cooling the exterior surfaces of food is also for beverage ice or used as food. Observed bar drinks being stored in ice used for customer’s beverages.
violations.corrective_action: After use as a medium for cooling the exterior surfaces of food, packaged foods, beverages, or cooling coils/tubes, the ice may not be used as food. EHS DISCUSSED WITH MANAGEMENT. EACH ICE BIN AT THE BAR(S) SHALL BE DESIGNATED FOR EITHER ICE FOR COOLING EXTERIORS OF CANNED/BOTTLED BEVERAGES OR ICE FOR CONSUMPTION. ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP AND TRAINING TO STAFF.

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Observed food and/or beverages directly stored on the floor in the kitchen areas, bar areas, and/or walk-in units.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. EHS INSTRUCTED MANAGEMENT TO PROVIDE MORE NSF APPROVED DUNNAGE RACKS AND SHELVING UNITS AS NEEDED TO EFFECTIVELY STORE FOOD/BEVERAGES OFF THE FLOOR AT LEAST 6 INCHES. ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wipings Clothes Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counter.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. EHS INSTRUCTED MANAGEMENT THAT STAFF MAY HAVE BOTH A GREEN BUCKET AND A RED BUCKET AT EACH WORK STATION. THE GREEN BUCKET WILL CONTAIN WATER AND SOAP WITH ONE TOWEL WHILE THE RED BUCKET WILL HAVE A BLEACH SOLUTION AT 50-200PPM AND ONE TOWEL. ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

out_items.name: In-use utensils properly stored

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: 1) CUPS LYING IN BULK BINS OF FOODS, 2) FOOD SCOOPS LYING IN THE BULK BINS OF FOODS OR ICE BINS.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. EHS DISCUSSED PROPER UTENSILS STORAGE. ALL FOOD AND ICE SHALL BE PROVIDED WITH A FOOD SCOOP DESIGNED WITH A HANDLE. THE HANDLE WILL SIT UP, OUT OF THE FOOD AND BE PROPERLY WASHED, RINSED, AND SANITIZED EVERY 24 HOURS. ENSURE TRAINING TO STAFF AND CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

out_items.name: Utensils, equipment and linens properly stored, dried and handled

violations.title: Equip/Utensils/Linens Stored off Floor, Clean Location
violations.observation: Observed cleaned and sanitized equipment directly stored on the floor in the kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Store clean equipment, utensils, and linens in a clean, dry location where they are not exposed to splash, dust, or other contamination and at least 6 inches above the floor. EHS INSTRUCTED MANAGEMENT THAT NOTHING SHOULD BE DIRECTLY STORED ON THE FLOOR. ITEMS SHALL BE AT LEAST 6 INCHES OFF THE FLOOR AND STORED ON NSF APPROVED SHELVING UNITS OR DUNNAGE RACKS. IN ADDITION TO NOTHING BEING ON THE FLOOR, THE CLEAN EQUIPMENT SHALL BE STORED UPSIDE DOWN. ENSURE TRAINING TO STAFF AND CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items No Reuse
violations.observation: Manufacturer containers for fresh peeled garlic were observed reused for the storage of other foods.
violations.corrective_action: Manufacturer containers may not be reused for secondary storage of other foods because the containers are not durable enough for multiple reuse and become uncleanable. EHS DISCUSSED WITH MANAGEMENT. ALL FOOD CONTAINERS ARE NSF APPROVED AND DESIGNED FOR REUSE AND CONTINUOUS WARE WASHING. DISCARD ALL REUSED GARLIC CONTAINERS AND REPLACE BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: Observed the following: 1) BURNT OUT LIGHT BULBS AT THE HOOD SYSTEM OR IN KITCHEN AREA CEILING FIXTURES, 2) CHEMICAL DISH MACHINE NOT DELIVERING CHLORINE SANITIZER AS REQUIRED AT 50-200PPM, 3) MISSING FILTERS FROM THE HOOD SYSTEM AT THE COOK LINE.
violations.corrective_action: Repair or replace as discussed. ENSURE CORRECTION TO ALL LISTED OBSERVATIONS BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, Durable/Smooth Materials
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surface of the following equipment is not corrosion resistant, nonabsorbent, and/or smooth: 1) ALUMINUM FOIL OR OTHER MATERIALS LINING STORAGE SHELVES UNDER WORK TABLES.
violations.corrective_action: Non-food contact surfaces of equipment that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other foods that require frequent cleaning shall be constructed of a corrosion- resistant, nonabsorbent, and smooth material. EHS INSTRUCTED MANAGEMENT TO REMOVE ANY MATERIALS ON EXTERIORS OF EQUIPMENT, SHELVING UNITS, STORAGE UNITS ETC THAT ARE ALUMINUM FOIL, NEWSPAPER, CARDBOARD, ETC. ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, Design/Construction
violations.observation: Milk crate(s) found used for the following purpose(s): 1) STORAGE OF FRESH PRODUCE INSIDE THE WALK-IN REFRIGERATOR.
violations.corrective_action: Milk crates, soda crates, and/or bread racks are not designed to store or elevate food, equipment, utensils, clean linens, and single-service items. Provide only ANSI-certified (such as NSF-listed) shelving units, storage units, or dunnage racks. EHS INSTRUCTED MANAGEMENT TO RETURN ALL MILK CRATES TO THE DAIRY SUPPLIER. ENSURE FOOD ARE PROPERLY STORED IN FOOD CONTAINERS DESIGNED FOR EASY WASHING BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

out_items.name: Hot and cold water available, adequate pressure

violations.title: Hot Water Capacity to Meet Peak Demands
violations.observation: Observed the current 75,100 btu gas water heater only delivering 73gph of hot water. Facility needs 116gph to meet the hot water demands therefore a 24% deficiency has been identified.
violations.corrective_action: Within 30 days, the permit holder shall replace or upgrade the water heater with a unit that meets the following design and capacity requirements: (1) Commercial grade, (2) Minimum of 50 gallon storage tank, (3) Minimum recovery rate of 116gph of 120fwater at a 80frise@, and (4) Specifications and installation meet National Sanitation Foundation (NSF) Standard 5. The permit holder shall provide the Health Department with the specifications (cut sheet) for the replacement water heater and obtain approval prior to purchase and installation. Please be reminded that equipment replacement or addition is not allowed without prior approval by the Health Department. EHS DISCUSSED WITH MANAGEMENT THAT THE GAS WATER HEATER IS UNDERSIZED. THE OPTIONS ARE TO REMOVE THE DISH MACHINE OR UPGRADE THE EXISTING GAS WATER HEATER TO A 120,000 BTU UNIT. ENSURE CORRECTION AND SEND SPECIFICATION SHEETS TO THE EHS WITHIN 30 DAYS.

out_items.name: Plumbing installed, proper backflow devices

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed the lack of an approved backflow prevention device on the water supply system servicing the slushy machines at the bar.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. EHS DISCUSSED WITH MANAGEMENT LOCATING A LICENSED PLUMBER TO INSTALL AN APPROVED BACK FLOW PREVENTION DEVICE ON THE WATER LINE SERVICING THE SLUSHY MACHINE. ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

out_items.name: Toilet facilities properly constructed, supplied, and cleaned

violations.title: Covered Receptacle in Women's Toilet
violations.observation: There is no covered refuse container for the disposal of feminine napkins in the ladies room stall.
violations.corrective_action: A toilet room used by females shall be provided with a covered receptacle for sanitary napkins. EHS DISCUSSED WITH MANAGEMENT. EACH STAFF IN THE LADIES RESTROOM SHALL HAVE A COVERED TRASH CAN FOR DISPOSAL OF FEMININE HYGIENE PRODUCTS. ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

violations.title: Toilet Rooms Enclosed
violations.observation: Observed the ladies restroom door not provided with a self-closing door.
violations.corrective_action: Provide a self-closing hinge or closing mechanism for the toilet room door. EHS INSTRUCTED MANAGEMENT TO RE-INSTALL THE SELF CLOSING DOOR HINGE ON THE LADIES RESTROOM DOOR BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

out_items.name: Garbage and refuse properly disposed, facilities maintained

violations.title: Receptacles, Provided for Paper Towel Disposal
violations.observation: There is no refuse container at the area immediately adjacent to the hand sinks.
violations.corrective_action: If disposable paper towels are used at handwashing sinks, a trash can shall be located at each sink or group of adjacent sinks. EHS INSTRUCTED MANAGEMENT TO ENSURE ALL HAND SINKS HAVE SMALL TRASH CANS NEAR BY IF PAPER TOWELS ARE USED TO DRY HANDS AFTER WASHING. ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Floors/Walls/Ceilings, Smooth, Easily Cleanable
violations.observation: Observed parts of the men’s restroom walls or wall coverings not designed, constructed or installed to be smooth and easily cleanable. Observed some of the ceiling panels in the men’s restroom not constructed of an easily cleanable surface.
violations.corrective_action: Floor, floor covering, walls, wall covering, and ceiling must be designed, constructed and installed to be smooth and easily cleanable. EHS INSTRUCTED MANAGEMENT THAT THE MEN’S RESTROOM WALLS NEED TO BE SEALED SO THEY ARE NON-ABSORBENT, EASILY CLEANABLE, AND WASHABLE. EHS INSTRUCTED MANAGEMENT TO REPLACE SOME OF THE ACOUSTICAL LAY-IN CEILING TILES IN THE MEN’S RESTROOM WITH VINYL COATED CEILING PANELS THAT ARE DESIGNED TO BE WASHABLE. ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

violations.title: Mops Allowed to Air Dry
violations.observation: Observed that mops are improperly stored between use.
violations.corrective_action: Store mops in a position that allows them to air dry without soiling walls, equipment, or supplies. EHS INSTRUCTED MANAGEMENT TO RINSE OUT AND HANG UP MOPS AFTER USE TO ALLOW AIR DRYING. ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP. DIAMOND LOUNGE (Inspection Date: 01/18/2025) Page 5 of 7

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed that the kitchen ceiling panels are not maintained in good repair. Observed small gaps/holes in the ceiling panels where electrical wiring or plumbing is located.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. EHS INSTRUCTED MANAGEMENT TO SEAL UP THE GAPS/HOLES TO PREVENT POSSIBLE ENTRY FOR INSECTS AND RODENTS. ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed that the kitchen walls are in need of cleaning.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. EHS INSTRUCTED MANAGEMENT TO SCRUB ALL KITCHEN WALLS TO REMOVE DEBRIS AND SPLATTER BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.
